name: Another Boring Piece
author: John Schmidt
description: Hand-picked fine art from anotherboring.day as your Omarchy background, with optional rotation on a schedule.

barWidget.description: Today's piece plus two more, set as your background in a click.

schema.label: Rotate automatically
schema.description: Pick a fresh piece on a schedule while the shell is running.

schema.label: Rotation interval (seconds)
schema.description: The panel offers 1, 3, 12 and 24 hours (3600, 10800, 43200, 86400). Any other value in range is honoured too, it just matches none of the buttons.

schema.label: Notify on change
schema.description: Send a notification naming the piece each time the background changes.
